sections.title: Short title and commencement
sections.content: This Act may be cited as the Public Procurement Act, 2020, and shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may, by statutory instrument, appoint.

sections.title: Application
sections.content: This Act applies to all procurement carried out by a procuring entity using public funds.

sections.title: Continuation of Zambia Public Procurement Authority
sections.content: The Zambia Public Procurement Authority established under the repealed Act shall continue to exist as if established under this Act.

sections.title: Functions of Authority
sections.content: The functions of the Authority are to regulate and monitor public procurement in Zambia.
